info.title: Azure Maps Route
info.description: Azure Maps Route API (atlas.microsoft.com) with GeoJSON request and response handling, plus static map images. Includes route directions, route matrix, route range, snap to roads, and static map, plus an MCP endpoint for Copilot Studio.

post.description: Returns the best route between an origin and destination, with optional waypoints, as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection. The request body is a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of waypoint Point features.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: Azure Maps API version.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Language in which routing results are returned, for example en-US or fr-FR.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body.

schema.description: This object is the request body.

type.description: Specifies the `GeoJSON` type. The only supported object type is `FeatureCollection`. For more information, see [RFC 7946](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7946).

features.description: Driving, walking, and truck routes are defined by a set of waypoints(stops) and viaWaypoints (intermediate locations that the route must pass through). You can have a maximum of 150 waypoints, and a maximum of 10 viaWaypoints between each set of waypoints. A route must have a minimum of 2 waypoints and the start and end points of the route cannot be viaWaypoints. Both waypoint and viaWaypoint locations must be specified as a valid GeoJSON Point feature object along with pointIndex that specifies the order of the locations. For more information on the GeoJSON format, see [RFC 7946](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7946).

items.description: Specifies the input waypoint and viaWaypoint `GeoJSON` feature object and additional properties. For more information, see [RFC 7946](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7946).

type.description: Specifies the `GeoJSON` type. The only supported object type is Feature. For more information, see [RFC 7946](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7946).

geometry.description: A valid `GeoJSON Point` geometry type. Please refer to [RFC 7946](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7946#section-3.1.2) for details.

type.description: Specifies the `GeoJSON` type. Must be one of the nine valid GeoJSON object types - Point, MultiPoint, LineString, MultiLineString, Polygon, MultiPolygon, GeometryCollection, Feature and FeatureCollection.

coordinates.description: A `Position` is an array of numbers with two or more elements. The first two elements are _longitude_ and _latitude_, precisely in that order. _Altitude/Elevation_ is an optional third element. Please refer to [RFC 7946](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7946#section-3.1.1) for details.

properties.description: Specifies the properties of a waypoint which is a specific location or point along a route or trip that serves as a reference or stopping point.

pointIndex.description: Identify and order the sequence of waypoints in the route. The default value is the `index value` of a features array.

pointType.description: Waypoint type on the route. It can be a stop or an intermediate location that the route must pass through.

travelMode.description: The mode of travel for the requested route. If not defined, the default value is "driving" that returns the route optimized for cars. `Note`: For truck travelMode, the requested truck route may not be available for the entire route. Where the truck route is not available for a particular section, the travelMode element of the response for that section will be "other". Example: "travelMode":"driving"

departAt.description: The date and time of departure from the origin point formatted as a `dateTime` value defined by [RFC 3339, section 5.6](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339#section-5.6). When a time zone offset is not specified, UTC will be assumed. If the `departAt` is not set, the default value is the current time. Example: "departAt": "2023-06-01T09:30:00.000-07:00"

arriveAt.description: The date and time of arrival at the destination point formatted as a `dateTime` value defined by [RFC 3339, section 5.6](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339#section-5.6). When a time zone offset is not specified, UTC will be assumed. The `arriveAt` parameter cannot be used in conjunction with `departAt`. Example: "arriveAt": "2023-06-01T09:30:00.000-07:00"

optimizeRoute.description: Specifies the parameter to use to optimize the route. If not defined, the default is "fastestWithoutTraffic" which returns the route to minimize the travel time without using current traffic information. Example: "optimizeRoute":"shortest"

optimizeWaypointOrder.description: Re-order the route waypoints using a fast heuristic algorithm to reduce the route cost specified with the optimize parameter. The origin and destination are excluded from the optimized waypoint and their position is considered fixed. Acceptable values are true or false.

avoid.description: Specifies restrictions that the route calculation should honor when determining the route. Avoid supports multiple values in a request and is only supported for the driving and truck travelMode. Example: "avoid": ["limitedAccessHighways", "tollRoads"]

items.description: Specifies restrictions that the route calculation should honor when determining the route. Avoid supports multiple values in a request and is only supported for the driving and truck travelMode.\n\nExample: \"avoid\": [\"limitedAccessHighways\", \"tollRoads\"]

routeOutputOptions.description: Include the desired route information from the response. By default, the itinerary is included in the response. Supports multiple values such as "routeOutputOptions": ["routePath", "itinerary"]

items.description: The desired route information from the response.

maxRouteCount.description: The maximum number of routes to return. Available for the driving and truck travel modes. Default: "maxRouteCount":1

heading.description: The initial directional heading of the vehicle in degrees starting at true North and continuing in clockwise direction. North is 0 degrees, east is 90 degrees, south is 180 degrees, west is 270 degrees.

vehicleSpec.description: Specifies the vehicle attributes such as size, weight, max speed, type of cargo, etc. for truck routing only. This helps avoid low bridge clearances, road restrictions, difficult right turns to provide the optimized truck route based on the vehicle specifications. `Note`: Only supported for truck travelMode

isVehicleCommercial.description: Whether the vehicle is used for commercial purposes. Commercial vehicles may not be allowed to drive on some roads.

length.description: Length of the vehicle in meters. A value of 0 means that length restrictions are not considered.

width.description: Width of the vehicle in meters. A value of 0 means that width restrictions are not considered.

height.description: Height of the vehicle in meters. A value of 0 means that height restrictions are not considered.

weight.description: Weight of the vehicle in kilograms. A value of 0 means that weight restrictions are not considered.

maxSpeed.description: Maximum speed of the vehicle in km/hour. The max speed in the vehicle profile is used to check whether a vehicle is allowed on motorways. A value of 0 means that an appropriate value for the vehicle will be determined and applied during route planning. A non-zero value may be overridden during route planning. For example, the current traffic flow is 60 km/hour. If the vehicle maximum speed is set to 50 km/hour, the routing engine will consider 60 km/hour as this is the current situation. If the maximum speed of the vehicle is provided as 80 km/hour but the current traffic flow is 60 km/hour, then routing engine will again use 60 km/hour.

axleWeight.description: Weight per axle of the vehicle in kg. A value of 0 means that weight restrictions per axle are not considered.

loadType.description: Types of cargo that may be classified as hazardous materials and restricted from some roads. Available vehicleLoadType values are US Hazmat classes 1 through 9, plus generic classifications for use in other countries. Values beginning with USHazmat are for US routing while otherHazmat should be used for all other countries. vehicleLoadType supports multiple values in a request.

items.description: Types of cargo that may be classified as hazardous materials and restricted from some roads.

adrTunnelRestrictionCode.description: The ADR tunnel restriction code. ADR is a European agreement concerning the international carriage of dangerous goods by road. The ADR tunnel restriction code is used to determine whether a vehicle is allowed to pass through a tunnel with restrictions on the carriage of dangerous goods.

axleCount.description: The number of axles on the vehicle.

signs.description: Signage text for the route. There may be more than one sign value.

durationTrafficInSeconds.description: The time that it takes, in seconds, to travel a corresponding `TravelDistance` with current traffic conditions. This value is provided if `optimizeRoute` includes traffic considerations.

departureAt.description: The estimated departure time for the leg, which takes into account the traffic conditions, is formatted as a `dateTime` value defined by [RFC 3339, section 5.6](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339#section-5.6). It will reference the timezone offset by either `departAt` or `arrivalAt`. If not, then the UTC time will be used.

It will reference the timezone offset by either `departAt` or `arrivalAt`. If not, then the UTC time will be used.

schema.description: Use to get a route matrix showing the travel time and distance for all possible pairs in a list of origins and destination. `GeoJSON` feature object and additional properties. Refer to [RFC 7946](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7946) for details.

features.description: A set of origin and destination points passed as GeoJSON MultiPoint features for the input matrix. Refer to [RFC 7946](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7946) for details on the GeoJSON format.

items.description: Specifies the input origin and destination points and additional properties for the `GeoJSON` MultiPoint feature object. Refer to [RFC 7946](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7946) for details.

departAt.description: The date and time of departure from the origin point formatted as a `dateTime` value defined by [RFC 3339, section 5.6](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339#section-5.6). When a time zone offset is not specified, UTC will be assumed. The `departAt` parameter cannot be used in conjunction with `arriveAt`. The `departAt` also supports: `any` value tailored to the use case where the time context is irrelevant. The `traffic=live` parameter value cannot be used together with `any`. `now` value to set the departure time to the processing time of each individual cell. Processing time may be any time between submission and its completion. This mode is best used together with traffic=live. Default value: `any` if `departAt` is not specified. Example: "departAt": "2024-12-01T09:30:00.000-07:00"

arriveAt.description: The date and time of arrival at the destination point formatted as a `dateTime` value defined by [RFC 3339, section 5.6](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339#section-5.6). When a time zone offset is not specified, UTC will be assumed. The `arriveAt` parameter cannot be used in conjunction with `departAt`. The `arriveAt` also supports `any` value which is tailored to the use case where the time context is irrelevant. The `traffic=live` parameter value cannot be used together with `any`. Default value: `any` if `arriveAt` is not specified. Example: "arriveAt": "2024-12-01T09:30:00.000-07:00"

travelMode.description: Specifies the travel profile to consider when calculating the matrix. If not specified, the default value is "driving". Example: "travelMode":"driving"

optimizeRoute.description: Specifies the parameter to use to optimize the route. If not defined, the default is "fastest" which returns the route to minimize the travel time. Example: "optimizeRoute":"fastest "

traffic.description: Specifies how traffic is considered for computing routes. Default value: `historical`

avoid.description: Specifies restrictions that the route calculation should honor when determining the route. Avoid supports multiple values in a request and is only supported for the driving and truck travelMode.

items.description: Specifies restrictions that the route calculation should honor when determining the route. Avoid supports multiple values in a request and is only supported for the driving and truck travelMode.

vehicleSpec.description: Specifies the vehicle attributes such as vehicle height, weight, max speed, type of cargo, etc. to consider when calculating the route matrix. This helps avoid low bridge clearances, road restrictions, difficult right turns to provide the optimized route based on the vehicle specifications. Vehicle attributes are specified within the vehicleSpec property.

isVehicleCommercial.description: Whether the vehicle is used for commercial purposes. Commercial vehicles may not be allowed to drive on some roads.

length.description: Length of the vehicle in meters. A value of 0 means that length restrictions are not considered.

width.description: Width of the vehicle in meters. A value of 0 means that width restrictions are not considered.

height.description: Height of the vehicle in meters. A value of 0 means that height restrictions are not considered.

weight.description: Weight of the vehicle in kilograms. A value of 0 means that weight restrictions are not considered.

maxSpeed.description: Maximum speed of the vehicle in km/hour. The max speed in the vehicle profile is used to check whether a vehicle is allowed on motorways. A value of 0 means that an appropriate value for the vehicle will be determined and applied during route planning. A non-zero value may be overridden during route planning. For example, the current traffic flow is 60 km/hour. If the vehicle maximum speed is set to 50 km/hour, the routing engine will consider 60 km/hour as this is the current situation. If the maximum speed of the vehicle is provided as 80 km/hour but the current traffic flow is 60 km/hour, then routing engine will again use 60 km/hour.

axleWeight.description: Weight per axle of the vehicle in kg. A value of 0 means that weight restrictions per axle are not considered.

loadType.description: Types of cargo that may be classified as hazardous materials and restricted from some roads. Available vehicleLoadType values are US Hazmat classes 1 through 9, plus generic classifications for use in other countries. Values beginning with USHazmat are for US routing while otherHazmat should be used for all other countries. vehicleLoadType supports multiple values in a request.

adrTunnelRestrictionCode.description: The ADR tunnel restriction code. ADR is a European agreement concerning the international carriage of dangerous goods by road. The ADR tunnel restriction code is used to determine whether a vehicle is allowed to pass through a tunnel with restrictions on the carriage of dangerous goods.

interpolate.description: Specifies whether to return additional points between the snapped points to complete the full route path that smoothly follows the road geometry. schema.description: This object is returned from a successful call.

type.description: Specifies the `GeoJSON` type. The only supported object type is `FeatureCollection`. For more information, see [RFC 7946](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7946).

features.description: `GeoJSON` feature object that contains Geometry object and additional properties. Refer to [RFC 7946, Section 3.2](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7946#section-3.2) for details.

items.description: GeoJSON feature object that contains Geometry object and additional properties of the route.

type.description: Specifies the `GeoJSON` type. The only supported object type is Feature. For more information, see [RFC 7946](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7946).

geometry.description: A valid `GeoJSON Point` geometry type. Please refer to [RFC 7946](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7946#section-3.1.2) for details.

type.description: Specifies the `GeoJSON` type. Must be one of the nine valid GeoJSON object types - Point, MultiPoint, LineString, MultiLineString, Polygon, MultiPolygon, GeometryCollection, Feature and FeatureCollection.

coordinates.description: A `Position` is an array of numbers with two or more elements. The first two elements are _longitude_ and _latitude_, precisely in that order. _Altitude/Elevation_ is an optional third element. Please refer to [RFC 7946](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7946#section-3.1.1) for details.

bbox.description: A rectangular area on the earth defined as a bounding box object. The sides of the rectangles are defined by latitude and longitude values. For more information, see [RFC 7946, Section 5](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7946#section-5). Example: "bbox": [-10.0, -10.0, 10.0, 10.0]

inputIndex.description: Identify the corresponding index in the original list of points for each snapped point. Only the snapped points will return indices and can be used to distinguish them from the interpolated points.

isInterpolated.description: Identify whether this is the interpolated point.

name.description: Name of the road the point is snapped to.

speedLimitInKilometersPerHour.description: Speed limit in kilometers per hour.
speedLimitInKilometersPerHour.x-ms-summary: Speed Limit In Kilometers Per Hour

get.description: Returns a static map image (PNG or JPEG) for a center point or bounding box, with optional pushpins, lines, polygons, circles, and a live traffic layer. Provide either center or bbox.

parameters.name: api-version
parameters.description: Azure Maps Render API version.

parameters.name: center
parameters.description: Center of the map as longitude,latitude, for example -122.33,47.6. Provide either center or bbox, not both.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Area to show as minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat. Provide either bbox or center, not both. Do not combine with width or height.

parameters.name: zoom
parameters.description: Zoom level from 0 (world) to 20 (street). Used with center.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Image width in pixels, 80 to 2000. Default 512. Do not use with bbox.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Image height in pixels, 80 to 1500. Default 512. Do not use with bbox.

parameters.name: tilesetId
parameters.description: Map style.

parameters.name: trafficLayer
parameters.description: Show live traffic on the map.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language for map labels as an IETF language tag, for example en-US.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Geopolitical view for disputed borders and labels.

parameters.name: pins
parameters.description: Pushpin definitions, one per item, for example default|coFF1493||-122.33 47.6. Longitude comes before latitude. Up to 25 items, each with up to 50 locations.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Line, polygon, or circle definitions, one per item, for example lc0000FF|lw4||-122.33 47.6|-122.12 47.67. Up to 10 items, each with up to 100 locations.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Image format returned. Default png.

post.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint for Copilot Studio. Provides GeoJSON route directions, route matrix, route range, snap-to-roads, and static map image tools.

api_key.name: subscription-key
api_key.description: Azure Maps account primary or secondary key.
